We welcome applications from all backgrounds and particularly encourage interest from women, underrepresented groups, and neurodivergent candidates. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the hiring process and are dedicated to creating a supportive, accessible environment for everyone. Senior NOC Engineer Location: Hampshire Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must hold active DV security clearance and be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations. As a Senior Network Operations Centre (NOC) Engineer, you will provide third-line network operational support for DXC's managed-service customers. Acting as a trusted technical authority and senior escalation point, you will maintain network availability within agreed SLAs, resolve complex incidents, deliver network changes and projects, validate configurations, and mentor junior engineers within DXC's ITIL framework for incident, change and problem management. Key Responsibilities Provide third-line network operational support and act as the senior escalation point for complex incidents. Maintain network operability within agreed SLAs and lead the analysis and resolution of complex network issues. Provide reactive support for high-priority and short-notice requests relating to in-scope network devices. Plan and deliver network changes and projects in collaboration with project managers and stakeholders. Produce network configurations, complete testing for BAU changes, and prepare associated test reports. Validate third-party configurations against approved standards, including node-acceptance activities. Support the implementation, testing and verification of node builds, equipment staging and physical patching. Follow Project Enhancement Release, change-management and ITIL service-management processes. Act as a trusted technical authority for network implementations and operational decision-making. Mentor junior engineers, support incident response, and promote knowledge sharing across the team. Keep internal and external stakeholders informed of project status, incidents, risks and change requests. Maintain network configuration, design collateral, operational documentation and customer records. Support continual service improvement through standards, policies, procedures and technical governance. Strong routing and switching knowledge, including BGP, OSPF, VXLAN, MLAG and STP. Enterprise firewall and SD-WAN experience, ideally with Fortinet FortiGate, FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer. Enterprise LAN and WLAN experience, ideally with Aruba CX, Aruba Central, Aruba WiFi, Mobility Master and ClearPass. Experience managing DNS, DHCP and IPAM services. Practical experience of network implementation, testing, verification and configuration validation. Strong working knowledge of ITIL practices and service-management platforms such as ServiceNow or SM9. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, written and interpersonal communication skills. The ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm, methodical and accountable during major incidents. Desirable Skills Network design experience and the ability to manage design collateral. Exposure to Microsoft Azure or cloud networking, Linux and Microsoft Visio. Previous network operations experience within secure or UK Government environments. A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline. Relevant vendor certifications such as Aruba, Fortinet or Cisco CCNP-level certification, or equivalent. ITIL Foundation certification. At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. review_candidates.title: DNS-GSLB Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. Verizon Global Infrastructure (VGI) seeks a highly motivated Cybersecurity Engineer to continuously evolve security standards. This critical role involves hardening Verizon’s Network, Cloud, and Application environments within the GTS ecosystem by converting complex security challenges into robust, enterprise-grade solutions. You will be instrumental in redefining attack surface management by designing a next-generation naming and delivery ecosystem. By integrating DNSSEC, encrypted traffic steering, and GSLB, you will bridge the gap between on-premise and public cloud platforms to ensure seamless, "always-on" security and automated threat mitigation across our global infrastructure. What We’re Looking For… Supporting daily operations, including internal/external stakeholder engagement and dotted-line leadership. Executing on the transition to hybrid-cloud environments by implementing fault-tolerant failover strategies that meet rigorous business availability and performance objectives. Identifying and solving for technology gaps in the design, architecture, and implementation of appropriate security solutions. Driving continuous improvement of network visibility and telemetry collection to strengthen detection and response capabilities Creating and maintaining technical standards, policies, and procedures to ensure smooth and error-free operations. Building and refining playbooks and response runbooks, ensuring repeatable workflows for high-impact scenarios (ransomware, phishing, insider threat, DDoS, etc.) Participating in Purple Team, Threat Hunt, and cyber security tabletop exercises. Supporting regular security control assessments validating configuration effectiveness and closing gaps discovered during incidents or hunts Promoting an environment of collaboration and individual accountability when it comes to problem-solving, decision-making, and process improvements You’ll Need To Have Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. Four of more years of direct, hands-on experience configuring, troubleshooting, and securing Citrix Load Balancers (NetScaler) and server load balancing (SLB) policies Proven track record engineering and maintaining Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB) architectures for multi-region active-active/active-passive failover and traffic distribution. Production-level experience managing enterprise DNS infrastructures (Infoblox, IPControl, or BIND) with a solid foundation in DNSSEC, zone delegations, and recursive resolver hardening. Strong command-line and systems administration experience within enterprise Linux environments, including networking daemons, service debugging, and TCP/IP stack tuning. Proficiency in Python and Bash to automate operational workflows, API-driven network tasks, and infrastructure configurations. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Expert in leading end-to-end digital transformations and hybrid-cloud connectivity (AWS, Azure, GCP), specializing in high-availability (HA), disaster recovery (DR), and resilient application delivery. Deep expertise in building CI/CD pipelines for network infrastructure using Python, Go, and Ansible to automate lifecycle management and configuration auditing. Experienced in deploying ML-powered AIOps platforms for predictive monitoring, automated anomaly detection, and self-healing recovery workflows. Advanced knowledge of securing management traffic and data-in-transit via Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), Proxies, VPNs, and robust encryption standards (IPsec, TLS). Senior-level proficiency in UNIX/Linux environments and a mastery of core industry standards including TCP/IP, HTTP/S, and IAM frameworks. Strong alignment with NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS benchmarks to ensure security integrity across cloud-native and hybrid environments. Industry Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, CCIE Security, CCE-N, or equivalent expert-level cloud networking credentials. Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.
